title: The Expanding Universe
blurb: Stand on any galaxy you like and every other one still recedes from you. Move yourself and refit — the answer does not change.

sources.cite: Riess et al. 1998, AJ 116, 1009; Perlmutter et al. 1999, ApJ 517, 565

open: The Hubble tension is unresolved at roughly 5 sigma. Both values are shown; neither is presented as correct.
Peculiar velocities are omitted — real galaxies scatter about the Hubble flow.
